pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 19H1 (May 2019 update) and above
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 Compatible GPU, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 19H1 (May 2019 update) and above
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 3.0 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 Compatible GPU, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
